description:
Find a pattern. Follow it deeper. Make it yours.

Fractal Forge is a fractal explorer and generative art studio with more than 1,000 fractals to discover. Travel through Mandelbrot and Julia sets, explore intricate 3D forms, and turn mathematical patterns into art for your screen.

Explore beyond the familiar

• Browse by category or search for a fractal by name.

• Discover Mandelbrot, Julia, Burning Ship, Newton basins, strange attractors, tilings, cellular automata, Mandelbulb and Mandelbox.

• Zoom, pan and rotate supported 3D fractals. Start with a preset or try the randomizer when you want a surprise.

Make the colors your own

• Switch palettes, create your own gradients and adjust fractal parameters in real time.

• Build symmetrical compositions with kaleidoscope effects, or add a text overlay.

• Experiment with your own formulas in Formula Lab.

Keep what you create

• Export PNG images up to 4K for wallpapers, prints and sharing.

• Animate zoom, pan and parameters with Looper, then export GIF loops.

• Save presets so you can return to a favorite look. Share a link that reopens your view.

• Explore Fractal Music and Fourier analysis for another way to experience a pattern.

Your studio, offline

No ads, no account and no tracking. Core exploration and creation work offline. Fractal Forge is free and open source under Apache 2.0.

High contrast, reduced motion, screen-reader labels and adjustable touch targets help you explore your way. Rendering speed and the depth of available zoom depend on the fractal and your device.

Open a fractal. Change one thing. See where it takes you.

description:
Uzora is a cross stitch chart viewer and stitch tracker: import a pattern file, mark every stitch as you go, and always know exactly where your needle left off.

The app interface is available in English, Russian, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Ukrainian, Polish, Italian and Dutch.

WORKS WITH YOUR PATTERN FILES

Import OXS and XSD charts, supported SAGA files and PDF patterns, or create a chart from a photo. Before you start stitching, Uzora shows what was read and reports anything unsupported honestly.

EVERY STITCH, RENDERED — NOT SKIPPED

Half and quarter stitches, petite stitches and beads are drawn on the chart exactly where the designer put them. If a file can't be read faithfully, Uzora tells you instead of guessing.

PARKING, BUILT IN

Park your needle mid-row and Uzora remembers where every colour left off — the technique confetti stitchers rely on, right on the chart.

NEVER LOSE YOUR PLACE

Mark stitches with a tap or hold to paint a whole run. Progress saves automatically as you stitch, survives interruptions, and can be exported as a backup file whenever you want your own copy.

STAY MOTIVATED

Daily streaks, session stats, gentle goals and a projected finish date turn a marathon WIP into steady momentum. See exactly how much you stitched today, this week and all time.

FLOSS TOOLS INCLUDED

Convert thread colours between DMC, Anchor, Madeira, Cosmo, Sullivans and Gamma, and see per-colour skein estimates for your chart before you buy floss. SAGA charts keyed in Gamma or PNK Kirova open with their own colours.

WHAT'S FREE, AND WHAT COSTS EXTRA

Free keeps up to five active patterns at a time, and includes one PDF chart import and one photo chart every month — three of each in your first month. Unlimited, an auto-renewing monthly or yearly subscription, lifts all three limits. Prices are shown in the app before you buy, and a subscription renews automatically until cancelled in Google Play.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Uzora is local-first: your cross stitch patterns and progress are stored on your device. No account is required and there are no ads. Product analytics can be switched off in Settings at any time.

A stitch counter, a chart keeper and a stitching diary in one app — for everyone who would rather stitch than count squares on paper.
whats_new:

A ZIP from the shop opens straight on the chart inside, and SAGA files with a damaged ending open too. Multi-page PDF charts are assembled in full.

description:
Artrace: AR Easy Draw & Sketch is made for users who want help turning a photo, character, or object into a drawing guide. Instead of starting from a blank page, you can use the phone camera to line up an image with paper and follow it by hand. As a result, the app suits beginners who need visual guidance and artists who want quick sketch practice. Users can download Artrace: AR Easy Draw & Sketch to practice drawing with a more guided process.


Artrace: AR Easy Draw & Sketch Features

Camera based AR tracing

Artrace: AR Easy Draw & Sketch uses the phone camera to place a guide image over paper or another drawing surface. You can set the phone on a tripod or a steady object, then trace what appears on the screen while drawing by hand. This AR Drawing method helps users follow shape, position, and proportion more easily.

Image import for sketch practice

You can import pictures from the gallery, take a new photo with the camera, or use an image found through the browser. After that, Artrace: AR Easy Draw & Sketch turns the image into a simpler outline that is easier to follow. This is useful when practicing portraits, characters, fanart, or photo to sketch drawings without needing to copy every detail at once.

Drawing categories for different interests

Artrace: AR Easy Draw & Sketch includes popular drawing themes such as anime, cute art, chibi, animals, food, people, eyes, flowers, vehicles, and nature. These categories help you find practice material that matches what you want to draw. For example, users who enjoy anime or character art can start with familiar shapes before moving to more detailed subjects.

Display controls for better tracing

You can adjust opacity, zoom, image size, flashlight, lock, reset, and other display settings while tracing. These controls help you match the guide image with your paper and keep it in place during drawing. In addition, changing opacity can make the outline easier to see without covering the real drawing surface.

Lessons, progress, and sharing

Artrace: AR Easy Draw & Sketch also includes structured drawing lessons, including a seven day course and different difficulty levels. As you practice, you can save or record the drawing process and share finished artwork with friends or the community. My Profile helps you keep track of your activity and see how your drawing practice develops over time.


Things to Know About Artrace: AR Easy Draw & Sketch

Artrace: AR Easy Draw & Sketch is especially useful for users who want to practice by tracing from personal images or online reference pictures. It works best when the phone is placed steadily, because movement can make the guide harder to follow. For cleaner results, users may want to prepare paper, a pencil, and a stable phone holder before starting.

User feedback often points to the app being helpful for beginners who want to draw many kinds of subjects, especially characters and anime style images. At the same time, some users mention that ads may appear during use, so the experience may not always feel uninterrupted. This is worth keeping in mind if you plan to use Artrace for longer drawing sessions.


How to Use Artrace: AR Easy Draw & Sketch

After installing the Artrace: AR Easy Draw & Sketch APK, you can begin with a simple image and use the camera view as a drawing guide. The process is easy to follow, but stable phone placement is important for accurate tracing.

  1. Open Artrace: AR Easy Draw & Sketch and choose whether to use an existing picture, take a photo, or browse for an image.
  2. Select an image that has clear shapes, then let the app prepare it as an outline for sketching practice.
  3. Place your phone on a tripod or a steady object so the camera points toward your paper.
  4. Adjust the image size, zoom, opacity, and flashlight until the guide lines match the drawing area.
  5. Trace the guide on paper step by step, then save, record, or share the result when your sketch is finished.


Start Drawing With Artrace

Artrace: AR Easy Draw & Sketch gives Android users a practical way to turn photos, characters, and objects into guided sketch practice. If you want camera based tracing, drawing lessons, and image import tools in one app, check the Artrace: AR Easy Draw & Sketch latest version before installing.

Choose your gears, pick your colors, then drag your finger to roll the gear and trace the pattern yourself, just like the real toy. Or hold one button and watch hypnotic patterns bloom on their own. WHERE MATH MEETS ART

The patterns Spirograph creates aren't accidents — they're governed by GCD/LCM and parametric equations. Hypotrochoids and epitrochoids come alive on your screen with two rolling modes (inside / outside). A visual companion for number theory and parametric curves — whether you're a curious learner, a math enthusiast, or just love beautiful patterns, this is where math becomes mesmerizing.

In 2022, Spirograph Maker was acknowledged in an academic paper on algebraic combinatorics (Billey & Weaver, arXiv:2207.06508). From a child's toy to cutting-edge mathematical research — that's how deep these patterns go.

KEY FEATURES

- Draw by hand: drag your finger around the gears to roll them and draw the pattern yourself

We successfully bridged the gap between digital imagination and physical paper using advanced AR technology, making learning to draw easier, faster, and more fun than ever.

Turn your smartphone into a powerful AR drawing tool today. Eliminate the need for expensive light boxes or professional projectors. Just look through your phone lens, lock your virtual AR guide, and trace lines directly onto paper to create a stunning, gallery-worthy masterpiece in minutes.

🌟 TRANSFORM YOUR DRAWING EXPERIENCE WITH AR

Drawing intricate designs has never been this accessible. Our advanced "AR Trace" technology projects any image from your phone directly onto a physical surface (paper, canvas, or wood). This technique is a digital evolution of the "Camera Lucida," utilizing Augmented Reality to help you achieve perfect proportions and perspective every time.

🔥 KEY FEATURES & MODES

1. AR Camera Projection Mode (Trace with Augmented Reality) Use your phone’s camera as a virtual AR projector to sketch on any opaque surface.

Stable Setup: Place your phone on a tripod or stable surface. The AR overlay stays visible while you trace on paper.

Precision Control: Use sliders for Opacity Control and Flashlight Integration for low-light AR drawing sessions.

Lock & Zoom: Zoom into details, then engage the screen lock to keep your AR sketch steady.

2. Screen Trace Mode (Digital Lightbox) Turn your device into a bright digital light box, ideal for quick sketches or thin tracing paper.

Touch Lock System: Place paper directly on the screen. The specialized touch-lock feature ignores hand movements, keeping the image stable while you trace.

Brightness Boost: Maximize screen brightness for effortless outline copying without using the AR camera.

3. Smart Grid Method Learn to draw using the proven technique of the Old Masters. Apply a customizable grid over any reference image.

Perfect Proportions: Break down complex images into manageable squares, ensuring accurate scale and composition before applying AR details.

Customization: Adjust rows, columns, and line thickness for any canvas size.

📂 MASSIVE TEMPLATE LIBRARY & CUSTOM AR IMPORT

Never run out of inspiration. We have curated a diverse collection of high-quality sketches and outlines optimized for Augmented Reality tracing.

Inspiration Library: Access popular categories immediately: Anime, Manga, Animals, Cars, Nature, and Food.

Gallery Import: Turn any photo from your gallery into a traceable AR guide.

AI-Powered Edge Detection: Converts imported photos into clean, high-contrast line art, ready for AR tracing in seconds.

📹 RECORD & SHARE YOUR AR ART JOURNEY

Document your artistic growth and show the world your process.

Time-Lapse Recording: The app automatically records a high-definition video of your AR drawing session.

Social Ready: Capture satisfying speed-drawing videos to share on social media reels and status updates. Prove you created the artwork by hand using Augmented Reality!

🚀 WHO IS THIS AR APP FOR?

Art Students: Perfect hand-eye coordination and learn complex proportions faster using AR visualization.

Content Creators: Create engaging time-lapse AR art videos for social media.

DIY Crafters: Easily transfer designs onto fabric, wood, or walls using Augmented Reality projection.

✨ WHY CHOOSE US?

We prioritize a seamless, lag-free user experience. Our engine is optimized for long drawing sessions, providing all essential tools—AR Overlay, Grid, and Lightbox—in one clean, user-friendly interface.

Download now and start your creative journey today!

description:
Turn your photo into a coloring page — Photo Outlines

Use AI to turn a photo into line art, then make it your own with brushes and a fill tool.

Enjoy coloring without having to draw the outline yourself.

You can also make full-color AI art, or add photo filters without AI.

From photo to coloring page

• Take a photo or choose one from your album to convert into an AI sketch.

• Pick from four Coloring Page styles: True to Photo, Storybook, Chibi and Digital Comic.

• Compare sample images to choose the look you prefer.

• Adjust line thickness, detail, contrast and background processing.

• Crop the converted page before bringing it to the coloring canvas.

AI Art Styles

• Turn a photo into color art in six original styles: Anime Film, Comic Book, Toy Figure, Watercolor, Pixel Art and Crayon. They don't copy any specific work or character.

• AI Flash relights your photo with a direct flash, like a night snapshot.

The samples illustrate each style; they do not preview the conversion of your own photo. AI results vary with the photo and settings.

Free Photo Filters, no AI

Give a photo one of 23 film, retro digital or B&W looks instantly and adjust the strength. Filters run on your device, so your photo isn't sent to a server and no AI conversions are used. Save or share at full size (up to 4096 px on the long edge), or draw on it. Some filters stamp the date the photo was taken (or today's date if unknown), and you can turn the date on or off.

Color it by hand

• 10 brushes, including pencil, marker, crayon, watercolor and eraser.

• A fill tool for adding color to closed areas.

• 79 stickers in two versions, Colored and To color in, that you can move and resize.

• A color palette and color picker.

• Undo and redo.

• Auto-save and the option to continue from Recent Works on the home screen.

Draw on photos without AI

Import a photo in its original colors and draw over it, or start a new picture on a blank canvas. These features are free and use no AI conversion credits.

Free access and things to know

• Get 2 free AI conversions a day. Photos are sent to a server for processing, so an internet connection is required.

• If your connection drops or you close the app during a conversion, you can still get the finished drawing within 7 days.

• After reaching the daily limit, an optional rewarded ad can add one extra conversion per day.

• Optional conversion packs of 5 or 20 are available to purchase if you need more.

• Before your first AI conversion, we ask for your consent (a parent or guardian must agree if you're not an adult; you can withdraw it in Settings). You can report an inappropriate AI result from the result screen.

• The app contains ads, and an ad may appear before entering the coloring screen or after saving a filtered photo. There are no ads inside the coloring screen.

• No sign-up or login steps are required to get started.

• App screens are in English, Korean, Japanese and Hindi (other device languages show English).

Enjoy coloring with PiPi, the parrot-pirate mascot of PiFl Labs.

Contact: support@pifl-labs.com

Export A3 at actual size. Print at the perfect size for your fan using the multi-copy machines at major convenience stores. Also supports A4 name boards.

By assigning colors to each role, you can switch color schemes with a single tap. Perfect for changing your favorite idol or switching colors for each tour.

■ Concert Calendar & Pre-Live Reminder

Register your concert dates and receive a notification two days in advance. Prevents you from forgetting to make your fan.

■ Time-Lapse Recording of the Creation Process

Save the entire process as a video. You can post it directly to social media.

■ Built-in Japanese, Korean, and Chinese Fonts

Create your favorite idol's name in Hangul or Kanji.

All features necessary for creating your fan are free. For those who want to remove ads, we offer a one-time purchase of ¥1,980 (not a monthly subscription). There's also a support tip option for those who want to support development, but it won't unlock any features.

description:
Qara - Digital Mandala Meditation

Create living mandalas with your fingertips, find peace in the process.

✦ The Ancient Art of Mandala, Reimagined

Qara transforms the centuries-old practice of mandala meditation into an interactive digital experience. Just as Tibetan monks create sand mandalas grain by grain, you create flowing particle mandalas with each gentle touch - watching them form, evolve, and gracefully fade away.

✦ What is Mandala Meditation?

Mandala creation has been used for thousands of years as a meditation technique. The repetitive, symmetrical patterns help focus the mind, release stress, and invite a deeper sense of calm. Qara brings this practice to your fingertips, allowing you to:

- Draw to Focus: Each stroke creates perfectly symmetrical patterns, guiding your mind back to center

- Watch to Meditate: Observe as your mandala evolves and fades, a gentle lesson in impermanence

- Create to Relax: The act of creation itself becomes a form of moving meditation

✦ Mandala Features

Sacred Geometry Controls

- Symmetry Points (1-10): Create traditional mandala symmetries, from simple circles to complex 10-point stars

- Spiral Patterns: Add sacred spiral elements found in nature and spiritual art

- Mirror Mode: Enable perfect reflection for enhanced mandala balance

Meditative Elements

- Life Time: Control how long your mandala persists - practice letting go as it fades

- Fade Speed: Adjust the dissolution rate for different meditation experiences

- Auto Play: Let mandalas create themselves for passive meditation sessions

Mindful Color Palettes

- Flow: Dynamic colors that shift like thoughts in meditation

- Mono: Minimalist grayscale for deep focus

- Ocean: Calming blues for a peaceful mood

- Sunset: Warm tones for heart-centered practice

✦ How to Practice Mandala Meditation with Qara

1. Set Your Intention: Choose your symmetry and colors based on how you feel today

2. Touch and Create: Let your intuition guide your finger movements

3. Observe Without Attachment: Watch your mandala form and dissolve

4. Find Your Center: The symmetrical patterns naturally draw your awareness inward

5. Release and Repeat: Each new touch is a fresh beginning

✦ Why Practice with Qara

- Unwind through focused, mindful creation

- Build a calm, present-moment awareness

- Enjoy a creative outlet for self-expression

- No cleanup or materials needed - just pure meditation

✦ From the Artist

"As a media artist, I've discovered that the process of creating digital mandalas can be as profound as traditional methods. Qara is my offering to those seeking peace through creation. Each mandala you draw is unique, temporary, and perfect in its imperfection - just like each moment of life."

Perfect for:

- Daily meditation practice

- Creative self-expression

- Mindful breaks during work

- Evening relaxation routines

- Creative meditation groups

Start your mandala meditation journey today. Touch, create, observe, release.

description:
KromoStudio is a complete drawing, painting, 2D animation and manga & comic studio

for your Android tablet. Big canvases, lots of layers and smooth, lag-free strokes,

with real stylus pressure and tilt.

━━ DRAWING & ILLUSTRATION ━━

• 180+ brushes: watercolor with real pigment simulation, oils, inks, charcoal,

airbrush, calligraphy, textures and manga brushes.

• Brush Studio to build your own: size, flow, spacing, scattering, grain, dual

tips and per-brush pressure curves.

• Import your Photoshop .ABR brushes.

• Layers with blend modes, groups, clipping masks and alpha lock.

• Selection (lasso, rectangle, magic wand, AI subject), transform, liquify,

clone, smudge, paint bucket and quick shapes.

• Perspective guides (1, 2 and 3 point, plus fisheye), radial and multi-axis

symmetry.

• Vector layers and a text tool.

• 30+ effects and adjustments: curves, levels, HSL, gradient map, blur and glow,

all with non-destructive preview.

━━ MANGA & COMICS ━━

• Panel cutter with straight or diagonal splits and adjustable gutters.

• Automatic per-panel masking, so your art never spills outside the frame.

• Vector speech balloons (oval, rounded, shout, narration) with dynamic tails that

point at your character, plus custom color, border and thickness.

• Screentones in dots, lines and noise, with adjustable frequency, angle and

contrast, applied non-destructively.

• Multi-page projects with a thumbnail filmstrip and drag-to-reorder.

• Page templates and a dedicated manga/comic workspace.

• Storyboard mode to plan the story before you draw it.

━━ 2D ANIMATION ━━

• Timeline with keyframes, multiple tracks and an X-Sheet.

• Onion skinning with adjustable opacity and red/green guide frames.

• Animated camera, motion curves and editable motion paths.

• Export to MP4, GIF and APNG.

━━ MORE ━━

• 3D Sketch (Kromo Depth): draw in real depth and rotate the scene.

• Double-page sketchbook.

• Background timelapse recording of your artwork, with video export.

• Layered PSD import and export; .clip and .psd import.

• Studio mode with dockable and floating panels and 3 workspaces

(Illustration, Manga/Comic, Animation).

• Light and dark themes, UI scaling and multiple languages.

• Autosave and crash recovery: if something goes wrong, your work is still there.

• Works with S-Pen and active styluses, with pressure and tilt.

━━ FREE & PRO ━━

Download and draw for free, with limits on layers, comic pages and animation

length. Unlock Pro with a single purchase, no subscription, to work without caps

and open Studio mode, 3D sketch, storyboard and the advanced timeline.

Your art is yours: projects are stored on your device.

🎨 Your Pocket Art Studio — Draw Anything, Anywhere! 🎨

⭐ 100% Free & No Ads ⭐

✨ If You Can Capture It, You Can Sketch It ✨

Can't draw? No problem. With AnySketch Neo, anyone can become an artist.

Trace any image through your camera with AR, turn your photos into anime-style art with AI, and share your creations with artists all over the world.

💡💡💡 Key Features :

- 🖌️ AR Trace Drawing : Seamlessly overlay reference images onto your paper through your camera for perfect proportions.

- 📸 Capture & Create : Take a photo of your surroundings or import from your gallery to start sketching instantly.

- 🤖 AI Anime Style Draw : Transform your photos into anime-style line art, ready to trace.

- 📚 Original Library : 228 professional official sketches — characters, animals, flowers, and more, growing with every update.

- 🔍 Smart Search : Instantly find the exact sketch you want, in the library and the Network Gallery.

- 🌍 Network Gallery : Browse, like, download, and share sketches with a global community of artists.

- 🔒 Screen Lock : Pin your sketch in place while drawing, so it never slips under your hand.

- 🎨 Personalize : Redesigned home screen with 38 beautiful wallpapers to choose from.

- 📱 Device Optimized : Perfect support for all screen ratios including Foldable devices and Tablets.

- ✏️ Refined Controls : Adjust transparency, outline thickness, and extraction quality in real time.

🛡️🛡️🛡️ Privacy-First Design :

- 100% Free & No Ads : No hidden costs, no in-app purchases, and zero ads. Our mission is to keep art accessible to everyone.

- Pure Privacy : Core tracing works fully on your device — no account, no login, and your photos and sketches never leave your device. Your creative process remains entirely yours.

- Gallery Only : Only the sketches you choose to post to the Network Gallery are uploaded to our servers.

- Stability Only : We collect anonymous crash and diagnostic data to keep the app stable. No advertising, no tracking, no data sold, and nothing is shared with third parties for advertising or profiling.

- Minimal Data : Only a self-chosen nickname is needed to participate in the Network Gallery. No name, email, phone number, or contacts are ever collected.

✅✅✅ Content Safety :

- Community Guidelines : Clear policies against inappropriate or infringing content, agreed upon before participating in the Network Gallery.

- Report & Block : Users can report inappropriate content and block other users directly from the gallery.

- Automated Moderation : An automated content moderation system is in place, and reported content is reviewed by administrators for further action.

🕰️ Our Story :

The Original AnySketch was first released in 2013 by JIN ATOLL. AnySketch Neo is its official, modernized evolution — re-engineered from the ground up for the modern mobile ecosystem with advanced AR technology.

🎻 Experience the perfect harmony of technology and traditional art. AnySketch Neo bridges the gap between imagination and reality.

✨✨✨ AI Feature Disclosure

The 'Anime Style Draw' feature in this app uses AI image generation technology. When you use this feature, your photo is sent to OpenAI's API servers (US) for AI style transformation. Transmitted images are processed and returned; they are not used for training purposes in accordance with OpenAI's API Data Usage Policy (https://openai.com/policies/api-data-usage-policies). Please refer to our Privacy Policy for details.

🎨 AnySketch Neo + Anyone can become an artist. + Jin Atoll

the one your eye happened to land on.

MATCHES YOU CAN TRUST

Every match is computed on your device with CIEDE2000, the industry standard

for perceptual color difference. That is where the match percentage comes from —

no guesswork, no invented codes. Your color is compared against:

• Curated paint collections from Benjamin Moore, Sherwin-Williams, Behr and

Farrow & Ball

• RAL Classic, the industrial standard (213 shades)

• A print and textile reference for physical production work

• Material Design, Tailwind CSS and the CSS named colors for digital work

Because the matching engine runs locally, results are instant and identical

every single time — the same shot always gives the same answer.

A FULL COLOR PICKER & PALETTE GENERATOR

Identify colors is only the start. The built-in tools turn any color into a

usable set:

• Convert instantly between HEX, RGB, HSL, CMYK and LAB — tap any value to copy

• Generate harmonies: complementary, analogous, triadic, tetradic, split

complementary and monochromatic

• Check WCAG contrast against black and white before you ship a design

• Build and name your own palettes, add colors by scan or by hex, and keep them

organized per project

• Browse your full scan history and return to any color you captured

UNDERSTANDS THE SHOT, NOT JUST THE PIXEL

Alongside the measured result, ColorScan describes the conditions of your photo

in plain language — the lighting, the finish, the likely material, and where the

color works well. It never touches the numbers: the codes and percentages always

come from the on-device engine.

BUILT FOR PEOPLE WHO WORK WITH COLOR

Painters and decorators matching an existing wall. Interior designers building a

scheme from a single fabric. Graphic and web designers pulling a brand color out

of a photo. Artists mixing from a reference. Anyone who has ever stood in a

hardware store holding a paint chip against their phone screen.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT

No account, no sign-up, no profile. Your scans, palettes and history stay on

your device.

AN HONEST NOTE ON ACCURACY

Screens and lighting vary, and the bundled paint collections are curated

selections of widely published colors, not licensed manufacturer fandecks. Treat

every paint result as a strong starting point and confirm with a physical sample

before you buy twenty liters of it.

Download Color Identifier: ColorScan and stop describing colors as "sort of a

warm greenish blue."

The "AI" in "AI Viewer" does not refer to artificial intelligence — it stands for the Adobe Illustrator file format (.ai). This app has no AI features; it's a viewer for opening professional design and document files directly on your device.

thefrog AI Viewer opens Adobe Illustrator (.ai), PDF, and SVG vector files, plus common image files (JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, BMP, HEIC, AVIF). EPS files can be viewed using their embedded preview image.

■ Key features

• Pinch to zoom in and out for a closer look

• Page navigation for multi-page AI (PDF Compatible) and PDF files

• Swipe to the next page or file, with a preview as you drag

• GIF and WEBP animation playback

• "Recent" tab — view and individually delete recently opened files

• "Folder" tab — opens the system file picker so you can find and open a file from any location

• Open directly from other apps (KakaoTalk, email, browser, etc.) via "Open with" — files opened this way also appear in the "Received" tab (this does not automatically collect every download on your device)

• Share the original file you're viewing, or save/share the current page as a PNG image

• Save as PDF (Plus): save AI (PDF Compatible), SVG, and image files as PDF — SVG stays vector, AI is saved as-is (animated images: first frame only)

■ About supported formats

AI files are supported only when saved from Adobe Illustrator with "Create PDF Compatible File" enabled. Legacy AI files saved without this option may not open.

EPS files are shown using their embedded preview image, so they may look less sharp than the original when zoomed in, and EPS files without a preview image can't be opened.

■ How it works

PDF, SVG, and image files are always free and unlimited, no purchase required. AI and EPS files can be viewed free for up to 5 different files in total. "Plus" (a one-time purchase, lifetime access, not a subscription) unlocks unlimited AI and EPS file viewing and Save as PDF.

■ Privacy

The content of files you open is processed entirely on your device and is not transmitted to a server. Works fully offline — no internet connection required. No account or sign-in is required, and there are no ads.

thefrog AI Viewer is an independent viewer, not an official Adobe app. Adobe and Illustrator are trademarks of Adobe Inc.

A file viewer app made by thefrog.

Motecraft is a calm-tech alternative to the engagement-engine apps that fill your home screen — a curated box of 250+ small visual worlds you can tap, drag, pinch, and breathe through, then close again.

Mandalas. Kaleidoscopes. Fractals. Auroras. Fluid and ferrofluid. Fireworks. Spirographs. Fidget spinners. Ambient scenes. Motecraft is a whole gallery of generative, physics-driven art in one app — and there is no score, no streak, no timer, no ads, and no leaderboard.

Each world is built from scratch in native Jetpack Compose Canvas — no game engine, no third-party graphics framework. Just arithmetic and a draw call, sixty times a second.

WHAT'S INSIDE

· Mandalas — long-press to pour embers, drag to weave henna lines, tap to bloom kaleidoscopes

· Auroras — pull silk curtains of green and cyan light across the sky

· Swarms — V-formations of geese that track your hand, flocks of bees, sheep that follow a shepherd

· Fluids — stir colour through a slow gradient, bloom ink in water, push ferrofluid spikes

· Fractals — Mandelbrot, Julia, Burning Ship, Newton — pinch into infinity

· Spirographs, fireworks, fidget spinners, candle flames, snow, ocean waves, window rain

… and 250+ worlds in total. New ones arrive in updates.

MOTECRAFT PRO

A premium collection of our richest, most detailed worlds — deeper colour, light, and motion. Unlock everything once, or subscribe. The free gallery stays free, forever — Pro simply adds more.

MOMENTS

Record up to 45 seconds of any Motecraft world and share it — Smooth (540p), Standard (720p), or HD (1080p). The recording captures only the canvas — no status bar, no chrome. Files stay on your device. Nothing uploads to a Motecraft server, because there isn't one.

WHAT WE LEFT OUT

· No advertising — not now, not later

· No third-party tracking — anonymous crash + aggregate event counts only; opt out in Settings → Privacy

· No leaderboards, streaks, or daily challenges

· Sign in only to restore Pro across your devices — browsing and the free gallery need no account

description:
See your next tattoo on your own skin before it's forever.

Inkproof is an AI tattoo generator and tattoo try-on in one app. Describe your idea, get an original tattoo design, then wrap it onto a photo of the exact spot you want inked: forearm, chest, calf, shoulder, hand or anywhere else you can photograph. No stock models and no guessing. When it looks right, take a true-size stencil to your tattoo artist.

How it works

1. Describe your tattoo idea in your own words.

2. Pick one of 10 styles and choose New or Cover-up.

3. Inkproof draws an original design. Not quite right? Regenerate it.

4. Take a photo of your skin or pick one from your gallery.

5. Drag, pinch and rotate the design into place and set the ink density.

6. Tap Wrap onto skin to see it inked into your own photo.

7. Share the preview, or export a free stencil (PNG, SVG or true-size PDF).

10 tattoo styles

Traditional, Neo-traditional, Fine line, Blackwork, Realism, Japanese, Tribal, Geometric, Watercolor and Script. Go from a single-needle fine line piece to bold traditional flash, a geometric mandala or a full tribal sleeve.

Made for real skin

• The preview is built on your own photo, not a model.

• Inkproof estimates your skin tone and keeps ink contrast readable on deep skin, so previews on darker skin don't wash out.

• Cover-up mode helps you plan a new piece over an older tattoo. It uses a denser design and softens the old ink in the preview.

A stencil your artist can use

• Clean 1-bit stencil cut from your design.

• Save it as PNG or share it as SVG.

• True-size thermal PDF: set the width on skin in inches. It's mirrored for thermal transfer, with a reading view to check it the right way round.

A licensed tattoo artist should still redraw and size any stencil before it touches skin.

Keep and share your ideas

• Share the on-skin preview with friends or your artist.

• Saved designs library and upload-your-own flash come with a Weekly or Yearly plan.

Pricing

Generating designs and exporting stencils (PNG, SVG and true-size PDF) cost nothing. Your first on-skin preview is also free and carries a watermark. After that, choose a Weekly or Yearly plan (unwatermarked previews, saved designs and upload-your-own) or a pack of 5, 15 or 40 previews. Subscriptions renew through Google Play until you cancel. You can cancel anytime in your Google Play subscriptions, and Restore purchases is in Settings.

Tips for a convincing preview

• Use good, even light and keep the whole area in frame.

• Photograph bare skin from the angle people will actually see it.

• Try a few ink density settings before you wrap.

Good to know

• For adults 18+. You confirm your age before generating a design or adding a photo.

• Designs and on-skin previews are AI-generated. They are previews, not a finished tattoo, and results depend on your photo.

• Original ideas get the cleanest results. Prompts naming celebrities or cartoon characters, and sexual or graphic prompts, may be blocked. Inkproof does not imitate living tattoo artists.

• Flag any AI result right in the app.

• No account or sign-up needed.

description:
Label Maker for the label sheets and rolls you already have: design a label on your phone, fill a whole sheet, and print it through your phone's print service or save it as a PDF.

▶ DESIGN A LABEL

• Text with size, bold, alignment and seven ink colours. Long text shrinks to fit, down to the smallest size you set, and the editor warns when it still doesn't fit.

• Barcodes: EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, Code 128 and Code 39, plus QR codes. The app checks the value (for example the last digit of an EAN-13) and warns when the bars get thinner than many scanners need.

• 44 line icons, rectangles, ellipses and lines, photos from your library or the camera, and today's date or a date some days ahead.

• Drag elements into place, rotate them a quarter turn, duplicate them.

• 9 templates to start from: pantry jar, storage box, file folder, school name, return address, 4×6 shipping, price tag, cable tag and freezer with a use-by date.

▶ FILL A WHOLE SHEET

• Numbered labels: start, step, how many, leading zeros, text before and after the number (001, 002… or BOX-01…).

• From a list: choose a CSV file (comma, semicolon or tab, up to 2 MB), put a column name in braces on the label and pick which column fills each field. One row per label.

• Copies of each label, or a column that says how many labels each row gets (0 skips the row).

• Up to 5,000 labels in one print.

▶ PRINT ON SHEETS AND ROLLS

• Built-in US Letter layouts with 30 and 10 labels per sheet, A4 layouts with 21, 14 and 65, and single labels of 62×29 mm, 54×25 mm, 4×6 in and 100×150 mm.

• Add your own size in mm or inches: label size, columns × rows, margins and gaps. The app checks that it fits the page.

• See the sheet to scale with rulers, every label numbered in print order.

• Partly used sheet? Tap the labels that are gone or skip the first ones, and printing starts on the next one.

• Print, share a PDF, or share one label as an image. No watermark is added to your labels.

▶ CALIBRATE YOUR PRINTER

• Print the calibration page on plain paper, measure two rulers and a cross, and enter the four numbers. The app corrects your printer's scale and offset for that sheet size.

• Each printer you name keeps its own corrections.

• Fine-tune in 0.2 mm steps, or print cell outlines on plain paper first.

▶ YOUR PROJECTS

• Every project saves as you work. Search, duplicate, and see which ones are marked as printed.

• Change the label size later and the design is scaled to fit.

• Deleted projects stay in Trash for 30 days.

• Save a backup with every project, its photos, your sizes, printers and calibrations. Before a restore changes anything, it shows what will be added, updated or left unchanged.

▶ GOOD TO KNOW

• Printing goes through your phone's print service or a PDF. The app does not connect directly to pocket thermal label printers.

• Labels come out at actual size when your print settings use 100% / actual size (not "fit to page"). The calibration page corrects your printer's offset.

• Built-in sheet layouts follow the published template dimensions. Do one test print on plain paper before using a full sheet.

• Text uses the system typeface; check tight text in the preview.

• Projects are saved on your phone. No account, no sign-in. The camera is used only when you choose to take a photo for a label.

• Ads appear on the projects list, when you come back to the app, and sometimes after you mark labels as printed. Never while a project is open.

description:
Mixura is the paint color matching app built for artists. Scan any color with your camera or pick from a photo — Mixura searches nearly 6,000 professional-grade paints to find your closest match in seconds.

Whether you work with acrylics, oils, watercolors, or gouache, Mixura covers 21 brands and 69 product lines, making it the most comprehensive paint color database available on mobile.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Point your camera at any color — a reference image, a real object, a painted surface

2. Tap to scan. Mixura captures the precise color value

3. See your closest paint matches ranked by Delta E 2000 accuracy

4. Get two-paint mixing recipes with exact ratios when a single match is not close enough

COMPREHENSIVE PAINT DATABASE

5,800+ paints across 21 brands and four mediums:

Acrylics (2,471 paints, 11 brands): Golden Heavy Body, Golden Fluid, Golden OPEN, Golden SoFlat, Liquitex Professional Heavy Body, Liquitex Soft Body, Liquitex Basics, Winsor & Newton Professional, Winsor & Newton Galeria, Schmincke PRIMAcryl, Schmincke AKADEMIE, Sennelier Extra-Fine, Sennelier Abstract, Matisse Structure, Matisse Flow, Amsterdam Standard & Expert, Daler-Rowney Cryla & System3, Vallejo, Holbein, Atelier

Oils (2,049 paints, 13 brands): Williamsburg Handmade, Michael Harding, Old Holland Classic, Gamblin, Sennelier Artists' & Rive Gauche, Winsor & Newton Artists' & Winton & Artisan, Schmincke Mussini & Norma, Maimeri Puro & Classico, Nevskaya Palitra Master Class & Ladoga, Holbein, Lukas, M. Graham, Daler-Rowney Georgian, Royal Talens Rembrandt

Watercolors (1,015 paints, 10 brands): Schmincke Horadam Aquarell, Daniel Smith Extra Fine, Winsor & Newton Professional & Cotman, Holbein, Sennelier l'Aquarelle, Golden QoR, M. Graham, Royal Talens Van Gogh, Daler-Rowney, Vallejo

Gouache (343 paints, 5 brands): Holbein Acryla Gouache, Winsor & Newton Designers Gouache, Schmincke Designers', Sennelier, Daler-Rowney Aquafine

SCIENTIFIC COLOR MATCHING

Mixura uses Delta E 2000 (CIEDE2000), the industry-standard color difference formula used by paint manufacturers and professional colorists. Colors are compared in the CIELAB color space for perceptual accuracy — not simple RGB matching.

Match quality ratings tell you exactly how close each paint is:

- Near-perfect: indistinguishable from target

- Excellent: barely perceptible difference

- Very good: slight difference visible to trained eyes

- Good: noticeable but acceptable

SMART MIXING RECOMMENDATIONS

When no single paint is close enough, Mixura calculates two-paint mixing recipes. You see the exact ratio, a visual preview of the mixed color, and the accuracy rating — so you know exactly what to put on your palette before you open a tube.

DETAILED PAINT INFORMATION

Every match shows: paint name, brand, product line, pigment codes (Colour Index names), opacity, lightfastness rating, and price series. Make informed buying decisions instead of guessing at the art store.

PALETTE MANAGEMENT

Save scanned colors into project palettes. Add notes, revisit matches anytime, and keep all your color research organised.

EXPORT & SHARE

Generate professional PDF reports of your color matches and mixing recipes to take to the art store or share with fellow artists.

FREE & PRO

Free: Choose 3 brands, see top 3 matches, create 3 palettes

Pro: All 21 brands, top 10 matches, mixing recipes, unlimited palettes, cloud sync, PDF export

Mixura Pro is available as a monthly or annual subscription with a 7-day free trial on the monthly plan.

Built for artists who care about accuracy. From matching a sunset for a landscape, to sourcing flesh tones for a portrait, to recreating a client's brand color — Mixura gets you to the right paint, faster.

description:
Every image has a color structure. Undertone shows it to you.

Undertone is a color study tool for painters, photographers, interior designers, and game developers. Take a photo or import one from your library. In seconds, you see the palette, harmony, temperature, and value structure underneath. All processing happens on your device. Your images never leave it.

PALETTE WITH PROPORTIONS

Not flat swatches. Undertone shows dominant colors by actual weight in the image. A 60% warm neutral with a 5% cool accent is a different color palette than 50/50. Every color labeled with hex codes and real pigment names. Yellow Ochre, not "Autumn Sunset Dream."

COLOR HARMONY

The relationship between your colors, identified and named. Complementary, analogous, triadic, split-complementary, tetradic, square, monochromatic. Or honestly, none. Not every image has a clean color harmony, and Undertone won't pretend. Colors plotted on a color wheel so you see the geometry.

TEMPERATURE MAP

A warm-cool overlay on your image that makes the invisible visible. Muddy shadows are almost always a temperature problem. Warm paint leaking into your cools. Toggle the temperature map on and the thing you couldn't diagnose becomes obvious. This is the feature that makes Undertone different from every color picker on the market.

VALUE STRUCTURE

Your image stripped to grayscale, divided into clear zones: light, mid-tone, dark. Value does more work than color. A painting with strong values and wrong color still reads. A painting with perfect color and weak values is mud. This automates the painter's squint.

YOUR COLOR LIBRARY

Every color analysis is saved to your history. No folders, no tags. A simple timeline you scroll. Revisit a master painting analysis. Pull up the mood board from last week. Your phone becomes a personal color reference library.

BUILT FOR PEOPLE WHO WORK WITH COLOR

Undertone is not a color picker. It does not generate palettes. It analyzes what exists and shows you the structure underneath. The gap between seeing that something works and understanding why it works. That is what Undertone bridges.

Free: 20 analyses at a time with the Original, Temperature, Values, and Saturation modes, plus the palette and harmony for every image. Premium adds Composition (10 guide types), Contrast focal analysis, tinted value bands, unlimited history, and full-resolution export. One-time purchase, no subscription.
whats_new: See the color structure of any image: palette, harmony, temperature and value. While an analysis is open the screen stays awake, so your reference waits beside the easel. The contrast map circles the areas that pull the eye, sliders follow your hand as you drag, and every export carries its analysis name and matches the screen.

description:
Curbside chains, sirens howling, low-flying aircraft ... Sounds like these show how the Cold War has shaped everyday life in the tranquil Münsterland. Listen to the entrance gate of a former munitions bunker when it is closed and listen to a mysterious radio station that only agents could decipher!

Put all these sounds together in your own combination and play one after the other or at the same time, such as the sounds of military contexts, such as maneuvers. Or only the cultural echo that the Cold War found in movies, songs and also in the radio coverage. Or combine it so contradictorily, as the whole conflict affected the participants: overlapping each other and confusing.

The project "Foreign neighbor - Life in the Cold War in Münsterland" aims to raise awareness of the economic, ecological and socio-cultural heritage of the Cold War era. In addition to the visit and mapping of places of the Cold War in the Münsterland - inaccessible, mysterious, partly forgotten, partly used today quite differently, is also worth the search for sounds of the Cold War.

The confrontation with the sounds of the Cold War should remind of this era and arouse interest in historical regional features. The project is funded by the Regional Cultural Policy (RKP) of the state of North Rhine-Westphalia and is part of the "Expedition Münsterland" of the Research Transfer Office (AFO) at the WWU Münster.

The Münsterland Expedition makes science locations in the Münsterland come alive and makes university research in the region visible. The project sees itself as a bridge between science and society. Starting points for many events are references from citizens who are interested in their surroundings and who then often play a decisive role in the implementation of the joint research events - in terms of content and organization.

www.expedition-muensterland.de

The sound collage was created in the project "Strange Neighbor - Life in the Cold War in the Münsterland". Are you missing a certain sound that you associate with this time? The sound collage is an ongoing project and is open to your suggestions. Write us at fremder.nachbar@uni-muenster.de

Note: This sound collage contains military sounds that can be problematic for sensitive or traumatized people. Please select only the everyday and cultural sounds, if you belong to this group of persons.

description:
Mix blue and yellow in almost any painting app and you get grey. That is not a taste problem, it is arithmetic: those apps average two RGB values, and averaging is not what paint does.

Pigment does what paint does. Every colour in the box is a named pigment with a measured absorption and a measured scattering strength, added together by mass the way two real paints combine in one puddle. Ultramarine and Hansa Yellow make a soft olive green because that is what the numbers say, not because somebody typed a green in.

WATER IS HALF THE BRUSH

Under the canvas is a shallow water simulation. Water runs downhill and wicks sideways into dry paper, faster into the low ground of the tooth than over the high. It leaves faster at the rim of a wash than in the middle, which drags colour outward and leaves the hard dark edge every painter recognises. Pigment travels with the water but slightly slower, so the wet edge always arrives before the colour does.

Drop clean water into a wash that has just lost its shine and the fresh water lifts what was settling and pushes it into a ragged rim. That is a backrun. There is no button to prevent it.

The water slider is the real instrument. Dry lays almost neat pigment and skips over the tooth. Wet lays a wash you can barely see.

TWENTY FOUR PIGMENTS THAT BEHAVE DIFFERENTLY

Ultramarine granulates into the valleys of cold press and lifts back off with a damp brush. Phthalo Blue never granulates, never lifts, and takes over any mix. Goethite is coarse natural iron ore, and a wash of it dries as a map of the paper. Granulation, staining, opacity and liftability are printed on the side of a real tube; here they are numbers the engine reads.

PAPER IS A DECISION

Cold press has tooth you can feel and collects granulating pigment in its low ground. Hot press lets washes slide and keeps every hard edge. Student cartridge drinks a wash before you have finished laying it, and buckles when soaked, which changes how the next wash pools.

EIGHT BRUSHES AND FIVE THINGS ON THEM

A mop, two rounds, a flat wash, an angled flat, a rigger, a fan and a sponge, every one of them running out of paint along the stroke the way a real brush does. Beyond paint there is clean water, a thirsty brush for lifting colour back out, masking fluid, and a hairdryer for drying where you point it.

THE MIXING WELL

A ceramic palette with real paint on it. Tap to squeeze a gob, drag to smear two together, and take the result away as a tube of your own. The smear is the same arithmetic the paper uses.

YOUR PROCESS IS THE FILE

A painting is not stored as an image. It is the log of every stroke: which brush, which paint, how much water, and the milliseconds between the points. Reopening a sheet replays the whole thing through the simulation. A painting of seventy strokes is about twenty kilobytes of stroke log.

That same log is the timelapse. Recording plays your strokes back through the physics and hands you a WebM video of the painting happening.

SIX GUIDED WASHES

A flat wash, a graded wash, wet into wet, the backrun, drybrush and lifting out. Each is a few minutes about water rather than about drawing.

HONEST ABOUT WHAT IT IS NOT

No gouache or oil engine. No layers. No community gallery, because that needs a server and this app has no network. Timelapse is WebM rather than MP4, because an MP4 encoder is not something an offline app can honestly claim. The simulation runs on the phone's processor, so a large sheet on an old phone runs the water more slowly. A stylus reports real pressure; a finger works too but its pressure is assumed rather than measured.

YOURS ALONE

Pigment does not request the internet permission, so Android will not let it open a connection at all. No account, no cloud, no analytics, no advertising ID, no crash reporter. Everything lives in this phone's private storage.

Every pigment, paper and brush is unlocked from the first launch. No subscription, no in app purchase, no advertising.

Paint that behaves.

A new face. The launcher icon and the first screen are now the same wet into wet bloom, painted by the engine that paints your sheet, and finished sheets sit taped down in the drawer.

description:
Google Flow Beta is built for creators who want to shape visual ideas directly on an Android phone. It focuses on turning prompts, photos, clips, and planned concepts into editable media, so users can move from a rough idea to a finished visual project in one place. In addition, the Google Flow Beta APK is useful for users who need mobile access to Google AI tools while working away from a desktop setup.


Main Creative Tools

Create images and videos from prompts

Google Flow Beta lets you generate images and videos with Google generative models, including Gemini Omni, Nano Banana, and Veo 3.1. You can start with a text idea, then let the app produce visual results that match the direction you describe. This makes the app suitable for concept art, short clips, visual tests, and early creative drafts.

Use your own photos and footage

You can upload media from the camera roll or capture material with the live camera. After that, Google Flow Beta can use those images or clips as visual reference for new creations. This helps when a project needs to follow a real object, location, outfit, face style, scene mood, or other source material from everyday life.

Edit with natural language

Google Flow Beta supports edits through written instructions, so you can describe what should change instead of manually adjusting every detail. For example, you can ask for a different look, change part of a scene, refine a video direction, or adjust a visual asset. As the project develops, the app also offers professional controls and asset based edits for more specific changes.

Keep projects connected across devices

Google Flow Beta includes a synced creative library for projects and assets. This means users can keep related images, videos, and creative materials together while moving between mobile and desktop work. As a result, the phone can be used for quick creation or review, while a larger screen can still support later editing or project management.

Finish and share completed media

Google Flow Beta can run multiple image and video generations in the background. When media is ready, the app sends real time notifications, so users do not need to keep watching the same screen. Finished creations can be downloaded to the device for sharing, and tools such as Type Overlays, Video Resizer, Image Editor, Storyboard Studio, Shader Effects, and Mockup help prepare media for different uses.


Google Flow Beta Before Downloading

Google Flow Beta is more than a simple image generator because it covers several parts of a creative workflow. You can plan ideas, create visuals from text or media input, refine results through conversation style editing, and prepare final assets with focused tools. This is useful for users who want one mobile workspace instead of switching between separate apps for every stage.

Availability and access may depend on the user account, region, and current beta rollout. Before choosing the Google Flow download, users should understand that beta apps can change over time as features are tested and adjusted. If a certain model, tool, or creation option is not visible, it may not be available for that account at the moment.


Google Flow Beta Use Cases

Google Flow Beta can support different visual projects, depending on the user’s goal. Filmmakers, artists, studios, and independent creators may use Flow style workflows for short films, music videos, concept art, fashion tests, and visual storytelling ideas. In this context, the app is useful when a creator needs to test several directions before choosing one final version.

Users who work with social content can also use the app to resize videos, add text overlays, prepare mockups, or turn early ideas into shareable drafts. For design related work, the image editor and shader effects can help test looks before exporting a finished result. These uses depend on the available tools inside the Google Flow Beta latest version.


How To Use Google Flow Beta On Android

After you download Google Flow Beta, start with a clear idea of the image or video you want to make. The app works best when the prompt, uploaded media, and editing requests all point toward the same creative goal. Then you can refine the result step by step instead of trying to finish everything in one command.

  1. Open Google Flow Beta on your Android phone and choose whether to begin with a text prompt, an existing image, a video clip, or a live camera capture.
  2. Describe the scene, subject, style, movement, or visual direction in simple words, then start the generation and wait for the app to process the request.
  3. Review the generated image or video, then use natural language edits to change details such as the subject, background, framing, color, or action.
  4. Use project tools such as Storyboard Studio, Image Editor, Type Overlays, Video Resizer, Shader Effects, or Mockup when the media needs a more specific finish.
  5. Save the finished creation to your device when it is ready, then share it through the apps or services you normally use for your creative work.


Start With Google Flow Beta

Google Flow Beta gives Android users a mobile workspace for planning, generating, editing, and saving image and video projects. If you need Google AI creation tools on your phone, download Google Flow Beta to test the available beta features and decide whether they fit your workflow.

description:
In today’s fast-paced digital world, artistic expression has evolved significantly. One of the groundbreaking technologies transforming the way people draw and sketch is AR Draw —a combination of augmented reality (AR) with traditional art practices like sketching and tracing. This innovation has brought forth several apps and tools, such as those designed for AR Draw Paint and Sketch, which enhance the artistic process, making it more intuitive and accessible for artists of all skill levels. If you’re interested in transforming your drawings into masterpieces, AR Draw Sketch and Trace apps are here to revolutionize your workflow.

AR Draw Sketch and Trace: The New Artistic Frontier

AR Draw Sketch and Trace tools have grown exponentially in popularity among artists, designers, and hobbyists alike. These apps allow you to project an image or reference directly onto your drawing surface using your smartphone or tablet. By overlaying an image onto your canvas through augmented reality, you can accurately trace to paper or any other medium, resulting in highly detailed and accurate sketches.

Artists can upload an image they want to draw, place it over the desired surface via the app, and trace along the lines using either a stylus or traditional drawing tools. This innovation is a game-changer for those who want to trace and draw, helping beginners and professionals alike improve their skills by practicing on more complex and detailed images.

AR Draw: Bridging the Gap Between Physical and Digital Art

arDrawing is not just about projecting images onto a surface. It allows for a seamless fusion of digital precision and traditional art techniques. Using AR Draw Paint and Sketch apps, users can superimpose digital outlines onto paper and follow along, mimicking the ease of digital sketching but with the tactile experience of physical drawing. Whether you're sketching a portrait, designing a logo, or drafting architectural plans, AR Draw Sketch and Trace tools ensure perfect proportions and angles by providing real-time overlays.

The integration of AR Draw technology helps artists overcome common challenges such as achieving the right proportions, understanding perspective, and creating detailed shading. Whether you are just starting or refining your skills, this technology allows you to practice more effectively by visualizing the end result as you draw.

Trace to Sketch: Making Artistic Mastery Attainable

One of the major benefits of using Trace to Sketch tools is the accessibility they provide for aspiring artists. Learning to draw can be intimidating, especially for those who struggle with getting proportions right. Trace and draw apps break down this barrier, allowing users to focus on improving their technique and building confidence.

By tracing over pre-existing images, artists can build muscle memory and learn the intricacies of different shapes, shading styles, and line weights. With enough practice, users eventually develop the ability to draw these designs freehand. Trace to Sketch tools can be particularly useful for learning how to draw intricate images like human faces, detailed landscapes, or complicated patterns.

AR Draw Paint and Sketch Apps: Perfect for All Skill Levels

The versatility of AR Draw Paint and Sketch apps makes them suitable for artists of all skill levels. Beginners can use these apps to learn the fundamentals of drawing by tracing images, while more experienced artists can use them to enhance their sketches with a higher degree of precision. These apps offer a wide range of features, from simple sketching to advanced shading techniques, making it possible to create both basic sketches and complex works of art.

FIT ANY ASPECT RATIO WITHOUT CROPPING

description:
Gold Name is a digital files and services platform for jewelers and for anyone who wants a custom gold-name design.

In one account you get: a jewelry design catalog, downloadable production files when the store has uploaded them, custom-name requests with status tracking, a B2B catalog studio, and Gold Pulse live gold pricing.

Who it is for

• Individuals: browse designs, request a name in a delivery format you choose, and follow gold prices.

• Workshops: buy executable files when available, build a branded PDF catalog, and keep purchases in My Library.

What you can do

1) Jewelry catalogs

Browse by sections and campaigns. Each model is paid (coins), free, or showcase-only — set by the store. Preview before you buy or download.

2) Digital files and DXF

When a file is uploaded you can purchase the format you need: DXF, PLT, and SVG for machines; PDF, AI, and CDR for editing; plus the catalog image. Files land in My Library with a reference number. If a format is not uploaded yet, request it from the same card.

3) Custom gold-name requests

Send the name, notes, and reference photos, and pick delivery formats. The coin price is a server quote before you submit. Track the job in My Requests until it is priced or delivered.

4) Catalog studio (workshops)

A four-step wizard: designs, layout and numbering, workshop logo/branding, then checkout. Saved catalogs show draft / processing / ready / failed, with download when ready.

5) Gold Pulse

Ounce-linked live rate, candlestick chart, local karat card (24, 22, 21, 18, 14) with your exchange rate, news, economic calendar, and price alerts. Sharing is an image card with the Play Store link.

6) Wallet, subscription, rewards

Top up gold coins via Google Play (personal and workshop packs). Coins buy images, files, name requests, and catalog generation. The monthly subscription removes ads and the share watermark and unlocks some studio tools — it does not unlock the file library for free. Optional daily wheel and tasks live in Rewards.

Payments and privacy

Purchases go through Google Play and RevenueCat. We do not store card numbers. Download links are signed. Delete your account in Profile → Account settings → Delete account. Deleting the app account does not cancel a Google Play subscription; cancel it in Play subscription settings.

Install Gold Name and start from the file you need: a design, a DXF, a catalog, or the gold price.
